items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free-style cleanser with no active ingredients is all a young face needs for washing morning and night.
A mineral SPF 50 fluid gives simple daytime protection on days spent outdoors, and it is a gentle choice for young skin.

response.routine_note: Wash your face with lukewarm water and a small amount of cleanser morning and evening, then pat dry, and apply sunscreen in the morning before going outside. Skip exfoliating, peels and strong active products at this age, and ask a parent or a dermatologist if you have any skin worries.
